_description: Tooling and operations decisions: test infrastructure, build, dev environment, dependency management. Append only; supersede with a new entry instead of editing.

title: Three vitest projects (unit, nuxt, server) with separate environments
context: Component tests need a Nuxt environment, unit tests need bare node, server tests need node with path aliases. Alternatives considered: single vitest config; Jest.
decision: Three vitest projects (unit, nuxt, server) configured in vitest.config.ts.
rationale: Unit tests need bare node. Component tests need Nuxt environment. Server tests need node with path aliases. Mixing them causes environment conflicts.
consequences_positive: Clean test isolation; each project runs in its correct environment

title: Nuxt 4 with auto-imports from shared/types/
context: Want type sharing between client and server without manual import boilerplate. Alternatives considered: monorepo with separate packages; manual type imports.
decision: Adopt Nuxt 4's shared/ directory for auto-imported types on both client and server.
rationale: Nuxt 4's shared directory enables type sharing between client and server without manual imports. Single source of truth for the API contract.
consequences_positive: Types are auto-imported on both sides; no import boilerplate

title: Zod for API input validation
context: Need runtime validation at the API boundary that integrates with TypeScript. Alternatives considered: manual validation; io-ts; class-validator.
decision: Use Zod schemas in server/utils/validate.ts for all API inputs.
rationale: Runtime validation at the API boundary catches malformed input before it reaches business logic. Zod integrates well with TypeScript for type inference.
consequences_positive: Type-safe validation with clear error messages
